title: The Vibe Coding Stack: Tools Serious Builders Use in 2026 (From Idea to Launch)
summary: The complete vibe coding stack for 2026: AI app builders, coding agents, deployment, and auth — what serious builders actually use from idea to shipped product.
body_markdown: Production-ready, with caveats. Blink's infrastructure (Postgres, auth, deploy) is the same stack used by production apps — not a sandbox environment. Stack A and Stack B ship real products with real users regularly. The ceiling on "production-ready" is about complexity, not scale: apps with unusual compliance requirements, custom infrastructure needs, or very complex data architectures eventually need custom engineering. For the 80% of products that don't fit that description, vibe coding ships production software.
